rules.label: IVA
rules.notes: Raw text retrieved on 2026-09-13 via curl -A "Mozilla/5.0" https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/informacao_fiscal/codigos_tributarios/Cod_download/Documents/CIVA.pdf (HTTP 200, 2,448,550 bytes, 188 pages), then pdftotext -layout. Art. 52.º n.º 1 (as worded by Decreto-Lei n.º 49/2025, of 27 March, in force since 1 July 2025): « Os sujeitos passivos são obrigados a arquivar e conservar em boa ordem durante os 10 anos civis subsequentes todos os registos e respetivos documentos de suporte, incluindo, quando a contabilidade é estabelecida por meios informáticos, os relativos à análise, programação e execução dos tratamentos. » — the TEN SUBSEQUENT CIVIL (calendar) YEARS (subsequentes): the reading adopted here is the settled one from Portuguese tax doctrine — the ten calendar years following the year the document/record relates to, hence counted from the END of the calendar year of issuance, never from the moment of archiving (the text never says 'a partir do arquivamento'). n.º 2 of the same article was read and changes NOTHING for an ordinary invoice: « Para os registos previstos no artigo 51.º e documentos anexos, o prazo de 10 anos referido no número anterior deve ser contado a partir da data em que for efetuada a última das regularizações previstas nos artigos 24.º e 25.º » — this n.º 2 sets a DIFFERENT starting point (the last VAT adjustment), but ONLY for the records covered by art. 51.º (deduction-adjustment records) and their supporting documents; an ordinary invoice falls under n.º 1 alone, without this correction.

notes: A single obligation identified so far for Portugal (CIVA art. 52.º, ten years). Established by the coordinator on 2026-09-13 (citation taken word for word from the tax authority's consolidated PDF); the origin axis (end of the calendar year of issuance) was added in that same session from the plain reading of « anos civis subsequentes » — no other invoice-specific retention obligation was researched beyond this article.
